name: com.labelixa/zpl
title: Labelixa
description: Thermal label MCP server: render, validate, debug and convert ZPL, EPL, TSPL and CPCL labels.

canonical.transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC over POST
canonical.authentication: Optional. Authorization: Bearer <lbx_ API key> (or X-API-Key). Anonymous use is rate-limited per IP.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.positioning: Labelixa is an MCP server and API platform for thermal label development: rendering, validating, debugging and converting ZPL, EPL, TSPL and CPCL labels.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.shortDescription: Thermal label MCP server for rendering, validating, debugging and converting ZPL, EPL, TSPL and CPCL labels.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.developerDescription: Give AI assistants and developer tools the ability to render, validate, debug, inspect and convert thermal printer labels through MCP.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.capabilities: Tools for rendering, validation, debugging, conversion, barcode analysis and printer compatibility.

artifacts.remote: Hosted server at https://api.labelixa.com/mcp: full tool set, versioned with the Labelixa API.
artifacts.local: npm package labelixa-mcp: local stdio server with a core tool subset that calls the Labelixa REST API.
